These examples are deliberately different: lower-entry apartments in Majan, golf-community apartments/townhouses in Dubai South, and waterfront apartments at Dubai Creek Harbour. Published starting prices do not guarantee a currently available unit.

CHOOSE THE INVESTMENT ROUTE

The right property starts with the job it must do.
01 · INCOME VISIBILITY
Ready / near-ready apartment

Prioritise actual rent comparables, service charges, vacancy and building quality over brochure yield.

BEST WHEN EVIDENCE MATTERS MOST
02 · STAGED CAPITAL
Off-plan apartment

Map every AED instalment into sterling and assess delivery, future competing supply and assignment rules.

BEST WHEN PAYMENT TIMING MATTERS
03 · LONGER HOLD
Townhouse / family home

Focus on schools, community maturity, maintenance, land scarcity and the long-term family tenant/buyer pool.

BEST WHEN SPACE SCARCITY MATTERS

PURCHASE COST + UK REPORTING

Budget beyond the advertised price.

For a resale registration, Dubai Land Department currently lists a 2% buyer fee and 2% seller fee, plus title/map and trustee charges. Off-plan and financed transactions have different line items. UK residents also need to assess foreign-income and capital-gains reporting.

01
DLD sale registration

Official service currently lists 2% buyer + 2% seller of sale value.

Contractual allocation may differ.
02
Transaction extras

Title deed, map, trustee/service-partner, agency and finance charges can apply.

Use a dated unit-level cost sheet.
03
UK rental income

UK residents normally pay UK tax on foreign income, including overseas property rent.

Reliefs and residence status can change the result.
04
UK capital gains

UK residents can face UK Capital Gains Tax on gains from overseas property.

Obtain qualified UK tax advice.

DUBAI GEOGRAPHY

Do not underwrite three districts as one market.

Majan, Dubai South and Dubai Creek Harbour carry different entry prices, supply pipelines, tenant profiles and exit audiences. Compare local evidence rather than applying one Dubai-wide yield assumption.

01 · MAJAN
Lower-entry apartment market

Useful for investors prioritising ticket size, but future supply and rent depth need careful testing.

EXAMPLE: SKYFLAME
02 · DUBAI SOUTH
Infrastructure-led growth corridor

Emaar South combines golf/community living with proximity to Expo City and Al Maktoum airport.

EXAMPLE: GOLF VALE
03 · CREEK HARBOUR
Waterfront premium

Higher entry pricing can reflect waterfront positioning, masterplan quality and a more lifestyle-led buyer pool.

EXAMPLE: CREEK BAY

UK INVESTOR DECISION LENS

Dubai can diversify the asset base. The UK obligations do not disappear.

Foreign buyers can own property in designated Dubai freehold areas. For UK residents, overseas rental income and gains may still create UK reporting and tax obligations. Treat ownership, sterling exposure and tax status as separate checks.

Ownership check

Confirm the exact property sits within an eligible ownership framework and verify title/project registration.

Sterling exposure

Model every future AED payment against a weaker-pound scenario, not just today’s booking amount.

UK tax residence

Residence status drives treatment of foreign income and gains. Check your position for the relevant tax year.

Remote operation

Price leasing, maintenance, vacancy, service charges and decision authority before completion.

NO TAX SLOGANS
Dubai and UK rules are treated separately.

NO GUARANTEED YIELD
Rent and resale assumptions are stress-tested.

CONTROLLED PURCHASE PATH

From a UK brief to a verified Dubai unit.
01
Set the sterling ceiling

Price, fees, completion reserve and a weaker-pound scenario.

02
Compare exact units

Layout, floor, view, payment plan, competing supply and service charge.

03
Verify the transaction

Developer or seller, registration, recipient account and dated documents.

04
Complete with advice

Use qualified Dubai conveyancing and UK tax/financial advice where appropriate.

PRIVATE ADVISORY REQUEST

Get a Dubai shortlist built around your sterling budget.

Share your budget and objective. I’ll compare current Dubai units, sterling exposure, purchase costs and the due-diligence questions that matter before reservation.
